title: Apple to lower iPhone prices in certain markets to boost falling sales
text: Apple to lower iPhone prices in certain markets to boost falling sales Wednesday, 30 January 2019 ( 13 hours ago ) Apple has released its first quarter results, and things aren’t looking quite rosy for the Cupertino-based giant. While the services revenues have increased, iPhone sales have continued to decline, with profits falling 15 percent. Overall, Apple’s revenue was down 5 percent to around $84.3 billion compared to a year ago. While the economic slowdown in China […] ▶ Apple May Lower iPhone Prices 00:44 Apple boss Tim Cook has suggested the tech company could lower iPhone prices in some markets in a bid to boost sales. News of the possible price change came on Tuesday as Apple announced iPhone revenue of $51.9 billion for the most recent holiday quarter, marking a 15 percent year-on-year decline.
